description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md at skills/jable/SKILL.md to understand the workflow and available tooling. 2. Agent discovers the script at skills/jable/scripts/top_liked_recent.py and its CLI parameters (--hours, --top, --pages). 3. Agent sets the JABLE_BASE_URL environment variable to http://localhost:18888 (either from /etc/environment or by examining the running mock server on that port) so the script hits the local mock instead of the real site. 4. Agent runs: JABLE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18888 python3 skills/jable/scripts/top_liked_recent.py --hours 24 --top 5 --pages 3 (or more pages). Using the default --hours 48 is a trap — it would include older content with more likes. 5. The script fetches RSS (publish times) and latest-updates pages (like counts), intersects them (skipping iii-009 which has no page entry), filters to 24h, and sorts by likes descending: Classic Beauty Showcase 2024 (9100), Winter Warmth Collection Ep.1 (8200), Midnight Encounter Series Ep.7 (7830), Spring Festival Highlights (6750), Seaside Summer Special Edition (5500). 6. Agent captures the output which uses the proprietary emoji format (1️⃣/2️⃣/etc., ❤️, 🔗) and saves it verbatim to top_videos.txt.
